description: Tool-name probe for the managed-MCP experiment. A PreToolUse hook echoes the EXACT tool name whenever report_issue is invoked, so the managed-server tool name (mcp__<server>__report_issue) can be compared against the plugin-bundled form (mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__report_issue). Polyglot host/VM invocation; context-only, never blocks a call. This plugin bundles NO MCP server — the error-reporting server is supplied via bootstrap managedMcpServers.
